source_evidence: Exact player 'Of course. Enter' acknowledges the warder's limited custody condition and authorizes armed entry into receiving hall with companions. Fenar leads to(0,10), V follows to(0,5), Cirren to(0,0) at inside threshold. Wight steps aside to(5,5), skeletons remain(-10,15)/(10,15), watch without attacking as agreed. Entry remains open, stair daylight reaches near hall, deeper areas dim/dark as applicable; party observes the visible older stone sleeping-platform recesses and communal bread ovens, later iron bars/fittings contrasting with refuge layout, in accordance with fixed prep. Cirren observes the fittings were added later; no proof of father's command, exact dates, prisoners' fate, V's identity or complete history. The warder gives bounded firsthand account that people were sheltered here before doors were secured and says his duty continued when contact with the House ceased; his account and self-justification not independently established truth. Visible eastward doorway at(15,25) leads farther into ruins; no further room access, surrender, property removal, evidence copy, investigation check or entry into other room. Wight asks whether V has come for the House records or custody itself; not an offer of unrestricted access or recognition. V's next choice. No time beyond ordinary immediate entry to ~16:32, no roll, attack, initiative, new resource expenditure, formal agreement beyond temporary armed entry/custody condition. Hessa and Mara remain outside.
